svg.text: Cut 394 x 314 mm from 6 mm exterior plywood; seal with varnish.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the inside of your case first: the board must drop in with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 2 mm all round. Trim corners to clear the case's mouldings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four posts: 20 mm square aluminium tube, 106 mm long, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 mm in from each side; screw up from below into a plug in each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Battery bay: 181 x 167 mm, 22 mm from the near end, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
